f2p: a raised character is displaced by its own offset and not by twice it
a lowered character is displaced by its own offset and not by twice it
characters raised and lowered on the same line each keep their own displacement
a displaced character on a later line keeps its displacement
the exported decoration thickness does not change when the text object is scaled
a character with its own decoration thickness keeps it when the text object is scaled
a displaced character on a path is offset along its own rotated baseline
p2p: characters with no vertical offset all share the same baseline
the tspans of a line keep strictly increasing x values when one character is vertically displaced
a vertically displaced character still carries its own font size
an unscaled text object still exports a decoration thickness proportional to its declared value
a character on a path with no displacement is unaffected by the path fix
